messages:
nina: Heads-up - after yesterday's RBAC rollout we're getting sporadic mTLS handshakes failing  eu-west -> ap-northeast. Audit shows KMS Decrypt AccessDenied where key ARN is in eu-west but request originates in ap-northeast.
oscar: Can you paste a sample audit line?
nina: ts=4132109995 api=Decrypt principal=svc-proxy-eu key=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:555555:key/xyz src_region=ap-northeast-1 result=AccessDenied
marco: likely cert provisioner picked a eu-west key alias for an ap-northeast workload. We recently enabled global issuer cache for cert-manager. Cache leak?
sylvie: Also saw an RBAC diff that removed kms:Decrypt from role svc-readonly-eu. If some pods are bound to that role in ap-northeast (selector mismatch) they'll be denied.
sec-bot: [ALERT] 4132110005 correlated KMS:DecryptDenied events=12 affected=svc-proxy-eu suggested_runbook=kb/kms-crossregion.
oscar: mitigation ideas: 1) restart cert-manager controllers in ap-northeast to clear cache, 2) temporary scoped kms:Decrypt allow for affected role limited to the ap-northeast key ARN, 3) tighten roleBinding selectors.
nina: I prefer 1 and 3 first, add 2 only if restart is slow. Marco - can you add TTL to the issuer cache and prefer issuer.region==host.region in selection logic?
marco: yes, will open PR to prefer region match and TTL=15s. I'll canary in ap-northeast.
sylvie: I'll audit roleBindings for selector overlap; flag any bindings where namespace!=roleNamespace.
sec-bot: [AUDIT NOTE] 4132110060 temporary exception authorized? none yet. Please record any policy changes.
oscar: oncall, run query: "api=Decrypt and key_region!=request_region and principal contains svc-proxy" for last 6h and paste top 5.
sec-bot: [QUERY] 4132110080 results: 5 rows - all key_region=eu-west-1 request_region=ap-northeast-1 principal=svc-proxy-eu
nina: confirms. Proceed with cert-manager patch + roleBinding fix. If we still see denies after patch, we'll create a 6h scoped policy exception and log it. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
